limitations: Counterevidence: The formal open exists, its identity object has a different materialization, and Remark3.42 provides an alternate smooth-generic-fiber route for this example. No false final theorem follows.

Counterevidence: Fixed-map rigid A.11 and uniquely lifted etale branch are not contradicted. Cor3.45's main proof does not use A.13. [1:pt] is a formal homotopy, so an alternative localized proof may work.
Counterevidence: Remark2.20 uses genuinely shrinking source neighborhoods, so no failure of the realization theorem is established.

Counterevidence: The correct two-summand torus realization gives R(Tred)=1[-1], which is invertible and repairs this stabilization step. Neither the intended stabilized realization nor the final Berthelot theorem is disproved; repairability does not downgrade an actual core proof defect.
Counterevidence: Cor2.28 uses the ordinary Ad_/S identity and restriction, so its construction does not require this claim.
